conceptZh: 玩具戰士的泡棉劍與盾牌不聽話，劍橫盾直互相撞成十字。
object: a toy warrior with a foam sword and a stubborn round shield
morph: the foam sword and a plank-like shield lock crosswise into 十
creativeAngle: 道具反抗：泡棉劍自己轉彎不肯橫躺，戰士最後用盾牌把它壓住，剛好十字相交；路口的紅綠燈小車補上十字路口。
promptEn:
An 8-second clip on a pale sky-blue backdrop with a soft grass-green floor. A chunky toy warrior in a dented tin helmet, big on bravado, carries a floppy foam sword and a round shield that keeps rolling away on its own. The off-screen voice, warm and clear Taiwanese Mandarin, says exactly: 「十、十、十字路口」 (ㄕˊ、ㄕˊ、ㄕˊ ㄗˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄎㄡˇ), slowly with clear tones, then stops.
0.0-1.6s: The warrior declares victory and plants the sword upright; it flops sideways like a noodle. 「十」 (ㄕˊ) is spoken as the sword droops.
1.6-3.0s: He lays it flat; the shield rolls over and flips it up on end; sword and shield trade places twice, the warrior chasing both.
3.0-4.4s: He outsmarts the shield: he sits on one end, and the sword bar drops crosswise on the upright with a satisfying clunk, forming a solid cherry-red glyph 十, about 70% of frame height. The second 「十」 (ㄕˊ) lands.
4.4-5.0s: Two tiny toy cars scoot in from left and right, stop politely at the crossing next to the glyph, and a little traffic light blinks; 「十字路口」 (ㄕˊ ㄗˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄎㄡˇ) is spoken as they meet at the crossroads.
5.0-8.0s: Hold: glyph 十 perfectly still, centered. The warrior salutes with the shield, helmet askew, off to the side, away from the strokes.
Only the glyph 十 appears as text; no subtitles, watermark or flashing. Light music below the voice.

conceptZh: 積木小隊要按一顆小按鈕，卻卯足全力衝過頭撞牆，彈回來時積木散開，橫一排、直一疊，剛好卡成「十」；隊長輕輕一按，月亮跳出來。
object: a squad of ten chunky cherry-red building bricks led by a googly-eyed sergeant brick, plus one tiny blue button on a stubby post at center stage
morph: the squad overshoots the button, slams into the frame edge, bounces back and skids to center; the crash shakes the bricks loose so a row clicks into a wide horizontal bar and the rest drop into a tall column through its middle, forming 十
creativeAngle: 全新「用力過頭」橋段：小隊為了按一顆小按鈕反而助跑衝刺、撞牆、冒煙滑回，散落的積木自己卡成橫豎十字，和前一版「劍盾相撞」完全不同。十塊積木呼應「十」的意思；詞選最安全的「十月」，由月亮跳出來做畫面對應。不需要第二角色，故未加入小老鼠，畫面保持乾淨。
promptEn:
An 8-second stylized 3D cartoon clip on a soft cream backdrop with a pale mint floor, bright and evenly lit, nothing busy behind. The lead is a squad of ten chunky cherry-red interlocking building bricks that march in a clacking conga line, led by a slightly bigger sergeant brick with two googly eyes and a tiny painted stripe. The squad is over-eager and uses enormous effort for every tiny job. At center stands a stubby post with one small blue button on top. The off-screen voice, warm and clear Taiwanese Mandarin, says exactly: 「十、十、十月」 (ㄕˊ、ㄕˊ、ㄕˊ ㄩㄝˋ), reading exactly those syllables slowly with clear tones, then stops.

0.0-1.5s: The brick line marches in from the left edge, stops, and the sergeant brick spots the little button and points at it with a stud: one gentle tap is all it needs. The squad snaps to attention and starts clicking itself into a wobbly stacked tower; the first 「十」 (ㄕˊ) is spoken as the stacking begins.
1.5-3.0s: Instead of tapping, the whole tower backs all the way to the left edge, crouches like a sprinter, bricks pumping and little puffs of steam rising, then rockets across the frame, missing the button by a whisker, and SLAMS into the right edge of the frame, squashing into a flat red pancake with a cartoon bonk and a wobble.
3.0-4.5s: The pancake springs back, bounces once, and skids back to center with tiny smoking feet, screeching to a stop right beside the post. The jolt shakes the bricks loose: a row of bricks clicks into a wide horizontal bar at mid-height, and the remaining bricks drop with a clack into a tall column straight through its middle, forming the solid cherry-red glyph 十, perfectly centered, filling about 70% of frame height with clean margins. The second 「十」 (ㄕˊ) lands exactly as the last brick clicks in.
4.5-5.5s: The dizzy sergeant brick, eyes spinning, totters to the post and gives the button one soft one-stud tap. Ding. A big round butter-yellow moon with a sleepy smile pops up in the upper-left corner of the sky, well clear of the glyph; 「十月」 (ㄕˊ ㄩㄝˋ) is spoken exactly as the moon pops into view.
5.5-8.0s: Final hold: the glyph 十 stays perfectly still, centered and fully readable, the moon glowing softly in the corner. At bottom right, away from the strokes, the sergeant brick does a proud wobbly victory wiggle and a tiny bow, never touching or covering the glyph.

Only the glyph 十 appears as text on screen; no subtitles, vocabulary text, watermark, logos, clutter or flashing effects. Saturated red strokes on a much lighter background, bright but not neon, no white blowouts, no dark grading. Light playful music kept well below the voice; no extra dialogue.
